title: Amenity trays
description: How many designs the Amenities panel's pop-up strips list (one row, "amenities", so a mod may write just the field). The art, names and prices of the extra designs are already in golf.exe; the original strips stop short of them (card task-45, docs/CUT_CONTENT.md).

landmark_designs.description: Landmark designs the strip can show (kinds 0 to this minus 1, those whose bit is in the available mask). The original shows 14; kinds 14 (oriental house) and 15 (dinosaur tarpit) have art, names and prices but no strip slot.

bench_designs.description: Bench designs the strip shows. The original shows 5; the sixth (the lovers' bench) is loaded and never offered.

sandbox_landmark_mask.description: Landmark designs a Sandbox game starts with, one bit per kind (the original 16383 is kinds 0 to 13).
